title: Coast Guard rescues woman, dog from bottom of cliff near Ludington, Mich.
description: A U.S. Coast Guard MH-65 Dolphin helicopter aircrew rescue a woman by hoisting her into the helicopter near Ludington, Michigan, July 19, 2019. The aircrew rescued a woman and her dog who had been stranded at the bottom of a cliff overnight. (U.S. Coast Guard video)
